observations: Photo 0: a white games console held upright in clear plastic wrap, Xbox sphere logo on the front corner, perforated grille on the top face.
Photo 1: the same console tilted, showing the full dotted vent grille across the top and the Xbox logo on the front; the shape and grille match the Xbox One S family.
The front face with or without a disc slot is not clearly shown, so disc versus All-Digital edition cannot be confirmed.
No power-on shot, no screen, no ports, no serial or rear label, no controller, no cables shown.
Photos are taken in a shop window with a dealer watermark; the plastic wrap hides any scratches.

identity.model: Xbox One S (edition unconfirmed, priced as All-Digital)
read_from: photo 1 Xbox logo and One S dotted top grille

claims.evidence: Logo and grille show an Xbox One S; the front face is not shown clearly enough to confirm there is no disc slot, and no label is shown.
The plastic wrap and angle hide the surfaces; no clear unwrapped shots of every face.
Internal history cannot be seen; warranty seals and screws are not shown.
No clip of it powering on and reaching the home screen.
No receipt or warranty card shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, overheat, or have a failed HDMI port
risks.proof: Clip of the console powering on with the handwritten code in shot and reaching the Xbox home screen on a TV

risks.risk: Console may be account or ban locked, or carry a reported-stolen serial
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > System > Console info showing the serial, plus a photo of the rear serial sticker

risks.risk: Edition and storage may differ from the claim
risks.proof: Clear photo of the front face and the rear or underside label showing model 1681 and storage
risks.if_unproven: as the cheapest One S edition, All-Digital, no extras

risks.risk: Controller, power cable and HDMI cable may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out together
risks.if_unproven: as console only, no controller or cables

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage hidden under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Unwrapped photos of all six faces in daylight

proof_requests: Clip of the console powering on to the home screen with a handwritten code in shot
Screenshot of Settings > System > Console info with serial, plus the rear serial sticker
Clear front face photo and underside label showing model and storage
Photo of included controller and cables
Photo of the receipt and warranty card
response.reason: The Xbox logo and the One S grille identify an Xbox One S, so it can be priced at its worst case as the All-Digital edition, console only, not working, until a power-on clip and labels prove more.
